blocks.title: zmux factory
blocks.text: tmux-style PTY session multiplexer in Zig: a daemon owns sessions, windows, panes, and PTYs; clients attach over a UNIX-socket JSON-RPC protocol. Incremental per-module Zig tests and benchmarks, coverage-guided fuzzing, and cross-compiled release builds run through `smthrs ci` with the build.smithers.sh cache.
